name: Pre-Engagement - Scoping Questions
command: # Key questions that define scope & effort
description: Pre-Engagement - Scoping Questions - reference (methodology, not a runnable command).
notes: Core scoping inputs: # of live hosts; # of IPs/CIDR ranges; # of domains/subdomains; # of wireless SSIDs; # of web/mobile apps; authenticated roles; phishing target count; will client provide the list or gather via OSINT; physical locations; Red Team objective; out-of-scope activities; separate AD assessment; anonymous vs domain-user start; NAC bypass needed; black/grey/white box; non-evasive / hybrid-evasive / fully-evasive.

examples.label: Network scope — enumerate all CIDRs and excluded hosts
examples.command: # Q: What IP ranges/CIDRs are in scope? Any excluded hosts (DC, prod DB)?

examples.label: Web scope — list all domains and authentication requirements
examples.command: # Q: Which domains/subdomains? Are authenticated tests required? WAF in place?

examples.label: Engagement type — define test style and deliverables
examples.command: # Q: Black/grey/white box? Evasion required? Report format (PTES/OWASP)?
